about: WYGWYL poem 07, DJ TURN ME UP: the line "So DJ please turn me up", as one registered cut-out passage
line: So DJ please turn me up.

states.visible: she reads from the page held low; the canopy shows the archive faintly (10%)
shoulder and upper arm lift first, forearm and hand lag
the hand travels on an arc to the 1956 knob
fingertip on the knob edge, held (camera pushed in)
the knob turns 75 degrees on "turn me up"; meter needle rises
the archive fills the canopy; the 1956 hand on the same knob answers in an inset
she lets go; the hand lifts off and falls back; camera pulls out wide
she reads on; the knob stays turned, the canopy stays lit, the needle keeps reading the archive

contacts.what: socket rides the knob as it turns
fingertip leaves the knob; contact marked released, not zero
both soles on the floor line for the whole passage (the skirt and legs are not animated)

material.canopy_mix: first-order lag on max(0.1, level), tau 0.28 s
material.needle: rest + 88 deg x level x (0.55 + 0.45 x archive loudness); loudness is measured per frame from the clip audio
material.crowd_tilt: -3.5 deg x canopy, each figure two frames after the last

cameras.rule: wide for the reading, in for the line, out for the result
